"""RoboLab limited-mode carton placement episode controller."""
import sys, json
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
obs = r.get_obs(video='frames')
print('time_left', obs.meta.get('time_left_s'), 'proprio', obs.meta['proprio']['now'], flush=True)
for cam, im in obs.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save('/app/output/current_'+cam+'.png')
# Camera calibrated table projection helpers. OpenCV extrinsic maps world to camera.
def table_point(cam, uv, z=spec['static']['table_top_z']):
    c = obs.meta['cameras'][cam]
    K = np.asarray(c['intrinsic_cv'], float)
    E = np.asarray(c['extrinsic_cv'], float)
    R, t = E[:3,:3], E[:3,3]
    ray_c = np.linalg.inv(K) @ np.array([uv[0], uv[1], 1.])
    origin = -R.T @ t
    direction = R.T @ ray_c
    s = (z-origin[2])/direction[2]
    return origin + s*direction

# Camera calibrated table projection helpers. OpenCV extrinsic maps world to camera.
def table_point(cam, uv, z=spec['static']['table_top_z']):
    c = obs.meta['cameras'][cam]
    K = np.asarray(c['intrinsic_cv'], float)
    E = np.asarray(c['extrinsic_cv'], float)
    R, t = E[:3,:3], E[:3,3]
    ray_c = np.linalg.inv(K) @ np.array([uv[0], uv[1], 1.])
    origin = -R.T @ t
    direction = R.T @ ray_c
    s = (z-origin[2])/direction[2]
    return origin + s*direction
